newsitem.title: USA: CME hog futures tumble on fund liquidation, stops.
newsitem.headline: CME hog futures tumble on fund liquidation, stops.

text.p: CME hog futures fell sharply as fund liquidation added to early pressure from weak cash hog prices and triggered sell stops, traders said.
Futures started downward as packers showed continued reluctance to purchase hogs in the face of declining cash pork product values and balance sheets that are in the red, traders said.
June dropped as much as 1.300 cents per lb and currently stood at 1.150 cent lower at 82.850 cents at 1014 CDT. Other months weakened 1.000 to 0.600 cent.
